metadata.title: Ganesha Pipeline v2.4.0
metadata.subtitle: SaaS, AI, Scale · 18 tasks · Phase IV

tasks.label: AMP Governance
tasks.description: Resolve open AMPs from Phase III before Phase IV begins

tasks.label: SaaS: Multi-Tenant Architecture
tasks.description: Phase IV.1: Database multi-tenancy (row-level security), tenant provisioning API, subscription mgmt, OAuth+SAML, per-tenant quotas, static analysis via FastAPI

tasks.label: SaaS: Auth & Billing
tasks.description: Phase IV.1: OAuth 2.0 + SAML SSO, Stripe billing integration, per-plan feature flags, tenant self-serve signup

tasks.label: GPU Acceleration: CUDA Kernels
tasks.description: Phase IV.2: CUDA ephemeris lookup, vectorized yoga detection, parallel transit checks, GPU batch API, progressive result streaming

tasks.label: GPU: Batch & Fallback Handling
tasks.description: Phase IV.2: 10,000-birth batch jobs, CPU fallback when GPU unavailable, job requeue on GPU failure, per-Tenant GPU allocation

tasks.label: LLM Research Copilot: Foundation
tasks.description: Phase IV.3: Fine-tuned transformer (astrology LM), RAG pipeline (retrieve Knowledge Graph → generate), embeddings for KG

tasks.label: LLM Research Copilot: Agent
tasks.description: Phase IV.3: Multi-step research agent (propose → gather → analyze → conclude), multi-chart NL comparison, PDF report writer from NL query

tasks.label: Partner Integrations: Import/Export
tasks.description: Phase IV.4: Import from Solar Fire/Janus/Morinus, export to Jigsaw/ZET/Swiss Ephemeris, iCalendar sync, webhook triggers, JPL ephemeris API

tasks.label: Subscription Tier: Billing & Marketplace
tasks.description: Phase IV.5: Free/Pro/Enterprise plans, usage-based GPU billing, researcher dataset marketplace, revenue-sharing with contributors

tasks.label: Cloud IaC: Terraform & Pulumi
tasks.description: Phase IV.6: AWS/GCP/Azure Terraform modules, managed Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) via Pulumi, RDS/ElastiCache, managed monitoring, backup/DR

tasks.label: Documentation: SaaS Developer Guide
tasks.description: Phase IV docs: Tenant provisioning tutorial, Kubernetes deployment guide, GPU setup (CUDA, drivers), cost estimation per tenant/GPU-hour

tasks.label: Benchmark: GPU vs CPU Validation
tasks.description: Phase IV.2+IV.3 benchmark: GPU latency at 1/100/10000 births, bit-exactness vs CPU, LLM accuracy (expert agreement >80%), hallucination rate <5%

tasks.label: Security: Penetration Testing & Compliance
tasks.description: Phase IV security: Pen-test multi-tenant isolation, SOC 2 audit, OWASP Top 10 review, data residency compliance, pen-test report

tasks.label: Governance: AI & SaaS Audit
tasks.description: Phase IV governance: AI model transparency (training data sources, limitations), SaaS TOS and privacy, LLM review process (human-in-the-loop)

tasks.label: Quality Gate: Full Production Validation
tasks.description: Phase IV QA: Multi-tenant isolation tests, bit-exactness GPU=CPU, DR simulation (RTO/RPO), load test, security scans

tasks.label: Release: v2.4.0 Tag, Changelog, SaaS Launch
tasks.description: v2.4.0 Release: Git tag, Terraform modules published, SaaS beta launched, pricing page live, migration guide v2.3→v2.4, changelog

tasks.label: SaaS UX: Tenant Dashboard & Setup
tasks.description: Phase IV.1+IV.5 UX: Tenant onboarding flow, billing dashboard, usage dashboards per plan, workspace switcher, admin panel

tasks.label: Multi-Region DR Infrastructure
tasks.description: Phase IV.6: Cross-region PostgreSQL replication (primary-cascade), failover automation, DR RTO/RPO tested, Terraform for multi-region
